title: Meta- and Google-backed Jio Platforms to raise up to $3.2 billion in historic IPO in India
summary_full: Jio's share sale will be India's largest ever in rupee terms, and second largest in dollar terms, trailing the Hyundai Motors IPO that raised $3.3 billion in 2024.
